verdict.rationale: CrewAI docs and GitHub README explicitly claim an observability layer that 'monitors and tracks agents in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces' and a 'Performance Monitoring' feature tracking execution times and token usage, which aligns with tracing LLM/tool calls. However, most detailed observability capabilities (real-time dashboards, webhook streaming, deployment monitoring) are tied to the paid CrewAI AMP/Enterprise offering rather than the open-source core, and no independent/community evidence confirms the granularity of per-call tracing in a UI.
